response.sql:
WITH site_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(m.facetregistry) AS mesh_record_count
  FROM sites AS s
  JOIN scanmesh AS m
    ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_metrics
  GROUP BY insurstat
),
kept_sites AS (
  SELECT sm.*, sa.status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_metrics AS sm
  JOIN status_averages AS sa USING (insurstat)
  WHERE sm.avg_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio
)
SELECT
  insurstat,
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_kept_site_ratio,
  SUM(mesh_record_count) AS total_mesh_records,
  AVG(avg_ratio - status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_over_status_average
FROM kept_sites
GROUP BY insurstat

assumptions.assumption: A site's mesh-record count includes every matching scanmesh row, even when its ratio is missing; AVG ignores missing ratios, and zero geometric accuracy is treated as an undefined ratio.
